title: TRES a fiber-fed echelle spectrograph for the Tillinghast reflector
numerical_result: TRES is a fibre-fed optical spectrograph with resolving power near 44000
remaining_question: Commissioning does not by itself define target-dependent RV precision

title: HAT-P-16b a 4 Jupiter-mass planet transiting a bright star
what_was_studied: TRES reconnaissance spectroscopy and stellar classification within a transit confirmation study
numerical_result: The paper reports HAT-P-16b with a 2.775960-day period and 4.193 Jupiter-mass planet
remaining_question: A planet-confirmation result is not an instrument precision specification

title: TESS follow-up observations with TRES survey products
